```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(kableExtra)
library(survival)
```

## Load the file using the file path

```{r}
data <- read.csv("C:/Users/anhha/Documents/colon/colon.csv", fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
data <- data %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.character), ~na_if(., "")))

kable(data) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE) %>%
  scroll_box(height = "300px")
```

## Filter the data with etype==2

```{r}
filtered_data <- data |> filter(etype ==2)
```


## Calculate the median survival time. -> 2552

```{r}
Y=Surv(filtered_data$time, filtered_data$status) 
kmfit=survfit(Y~1)
print(kmfit, digits = 4)
```

## Create a graph of KM estimated survival functions

```{r}
kmfit2=survfit(Y~filtered_data$node4)
plot(kmfit2, conf.int=T, lty = c('solid', 'dashed'), col=c('red','blue'), xlab='survival time in days',ylab='survival probabilities')
legend('topright', c('More than 4 positive lymph nodes','Less or equal than 4 positive lymph nodes'), lty=c('solid','dashed'), col=c('red','blue'))
```

## Use the log-rank test for rx variable.

```{r}
lr_test <- survdiff(Y ~ rx, data = filtered_data)
lr_test
```
## Use a Cox proportional hazards model to estimate hazard ratios for the effects of rx, age, sex, node4.

```{r}
mod1 <- coxph(Y ~ rx + sex + node4 + age, data = filtered_data)
summary(mod1)
```
## Harrell's C-statistic

```{r}
library(survival)

fit <- coxph(Surv(time, status) ~ age + sex + node4 + rx, data = filtered_data)

concordance(fit)
```



## Assessing the proportional hazards assumption with a statistical test.

```{r}
mod1 <- coxph(Y ~ rx + sex + node4 + age, data = filtered_data)
cox.zph(mod1, terms = FALSE, transform = "rank")
```

## Plot the survival curves of male patient age of 70, treatment with Lev+5FU, more than 4 lymph nodes

```{r}
filtered_data$rx_factor = factor(filtered_data$rx)
mod1 <- coxph(Y ~ rx + sex + node4 + age, data = filtered_data)
summary(mod1)
pattern1 <- data.frame(
  age = 70,
  sex = 1,
  rx = "Lev+5FU",
  node4 = 1
)
plot(survfit(mod1,newdata=pattern1),conf.int=F,main='Predicted Survival Function\nMale, Age 70, Lev+5FU, Nodes=2')
```
## Last observed survival probability 
```{r}
tail(summary(survfit(mod1, newdata=pattern1))$surv, 1)
```


## Extended cox model

```{r}
filtered_data.cp1095=survSplit(filtered_data,cut=1095, end="time", event="status",start="start",id="new_id")
filtered_data.cp1095$hv1=filtered_data.cp1095$node4*(filtered_data.cp1095$start<1095)
filtered_data.cp1095$hv2=filtered_data.cp1095$node4*(filtered_data.cp1095$start>=1095)

Y1095 = Surv(filtered_data.cp1095$start,filtered_data.cp1095$time, filtered_data.cp1095$status)

coxph(Y1095 ~ rx + age + sex + hv1 + hv2 +cluster(id), data=filtered_data.cp1095)

```


## AFT model

```{r}

modpar2=survreg(Surv(time, status)  ~ rx_factor + sex + node4 + age ,data=filtered_data,dist="weibull")
summary(modpar2)
```
